thought: Configured the floating VIP only on edge2 eth1 as required, without changing existing management addressing or flushing any firewall state. Added a TCP DNAT rule from 203.0.113.100:8080 to 10.0.2.100:8080, plus forward allow rules for the inbound and return legs of the connection. Added MASQUERADE in POSTROUTING on edge2 so reply traffic is symmetric through edge2. The server already has a route to 10.0.2.1 on eth2, but its preferred default route pointed out eth0; replacing the default route to use 10.0.2.1 ensures return traffic to the VIP follows the DNAT gateway on the data plane.
